an7.24:1.1: Satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi . . .
an7.24:1.3: Katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
an7.24:2.1: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū na kammārāmā bhavissanti na kammaratā na kammārāmataṃ anuyuttā, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.24:3.1: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū na bhassārāmā bhavissanti . . .
an7.24:3.4: na pāpicchā bhavissanti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā . . .
an7.24:3.5: na pāpamittā bhavissanti na pāpasahāyā na pāpasampavaṅkā . . .
an7.24:3.6: na oramattakena visesādhigamena antarā vosānaṃ āpajjissanti, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.24:4.1: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī
